source_caption:
Meet the Blacks follows Carl Black, a man who moves his family to Beverly Hills after unexpectedly becoming wealthy. Hoping for a better life, they arrive just as the city prepares for a strange annual event where all crime becomes legal for one night. The family must survive the chaos while dealing with their own personal problems.

In Meet the Blacks, the film parodies horror movies, especially The Purge, while using exaggerated humor and outrageous situations. The story combines comedy, satire, and light horror elements as the family encounters bizarre neighbors and dangerous criminals. Known for its over-the-top jokes and parody style, it became a popular comedy among fans of spoof films.

source_details.title: Meet the Blacks
source_details.synopsis: Meet the Blacks is a 2016 American black comedy horror film directed by Deon Taylor, written by Taylor and Nicole DeMasi, and is a parody of the 2013 film The Purge. It stars Mike Epps, Gary Owen, Zulay Henao, Lil Duval, Bresha Webb, George Lopez and Mike Tyson. This was Charlie Murphy's last film role before his death from leukemia in 2017 as well as the final role for Paul Mooney, who died in 2021. The film was released on April 1, 2016, by Freestyle Releasing. Although the film received generally negative reviews from critics, it was a box-office success, grossing over $9 million on its $900,000 budget. A sequel, titled The House Next Door: Meet the Blacks 2, was released on June 11, 2021
